message.content: Progress from the first session showed Roger attended and said he was not feeling the greatest while dealing with anxiety, depression, and disability collection for traumatic brain injury at the Turning Point shelter. He reported a tough time focusing and that when his focus felt off, a lot of things felt off, which distresses him. We discussed anxiety and depression scores of 2 and 3, which are not too bad, and reviewed his history of substance use without current desire to use because it causes too many problems. Intervention and response method included psychoeducation, collaborative problem-solving, and focus-support strategies to reduce distress around concentration. How will Roger track his focus and mood between sessions? What supports can help him maintain stability at the Turning Point shelter?
